title: Zing plan graph
description: Topology of a Zing plan: ordered steps, each containing a small DAG of nodes and edges, plus optional cross-flows that wire steps together. Generated by /zing/plan, /zing/plan-audit, and /zing/build-audit. Coordinates are NEVER stored here — layout runs server-side at view time.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema's URL. Ignored by the validator; useful for editor support.

title.description: Human-readable plan title. Shown in the plan-detail page header. Must match the H1 of the sibling .md file.

ticket.description: Optional Linear ticket identifier (e.g. "BAK-1321"). When present, must match the ticket_id in the .md file's YAML frontmatter.

kinds.description: Taxonomy of cross-flow kinds used in this plan. Keys are short slugs (e.g. "data", "control"); values are objects with a human label. Prefer the canonical six (data, control, schema, queue, utility, observability); add new kinds only when the plan genuinely needs one. Every cross_flows[].kind MUST resolve to a key here when this object is present.

label.description: Display label for this kind (e.g. "data flows in").

steps.description: Ordered list of plan steps, each a small DAG of nodes and edges. Step numbers must be unique across this array. Step IDs must be unique across this array.

cross_flows.description: Edges that wire one step's output to another step's input. Each entry references a (step, node) pair on each end. CROSS-REFERENCE RULES (validator enforces): (1) every from_step and to_step MUST resolve to a steps[].step value, (2) every from_node MUST resolve to a node.id within the from_step, (3) every to_node MUST resolve to a node.id within the to_step, (4) every kind MUST resolve to a key in the top-level kinds object when kinds is present.

step.description: One numbered step in the plan. Renders as a single card in the viewer with its own internal DAG.
Step number, 1-indexed. Must be unique across the plan. Determines display order.

id.description: Stable slug for this step (snake_case, e.g. "schema_migration_0135"). Must be unique across the plan. Used for cross-references and stable DOM ids.

title.description: Short human-readable step title shown in the card header.

concern.description: Optional one-sentence statement of what this step addresses or why it matters. Shown as a subtitle under the step title.

nodes.description: The internal DAG of this step. Node ids must be unique within this step (but can collide with ids in other steps).

edges.description: Edges between nodes within this step. Both `from` and `to` MUST resolve to node ids in this step's nodes[].

node.description: One node inside a step's DAG. Shape determines visual primitive; side determines colour/border treatment.

id.description: Slug for this node (kebab-case, e.g. "fk-div"). Must be unique within the parent step. Cross-flows reference this id.

shape.description: Visual primitive. rect = operation; diamond = decision/branch; hexagon = pre-existing module; parallelogram = input/output boundary; diverged = same site with different behaviour today vs proposed (REQUIRES side=diverged and the today_label/proposed_label/concern fields).

side.description: Visual treatment. shared = unchanged; existing = present today, will be removed; proposed = new in this plan; diverged = same site with split behaviour (only valid with shape=diverged).

label.description: Display text inside the shape. Keep concise (under ~60 chars). For diverged nodes, this is unused — see today_label/proposed_label.

concern.description: REQUIRED for shape=diverged: header text describing what diverges (e.g. "on_delete behaviour"). Ignored for other shapes.

today_label.description: REQUIRED for shape=diverged: text for the "today" half (e.g. "CASCADE — wipes activities"). Ignored for other shapes.

proposed_label.description: REQUIRED for shape=diverged: text for the "proposed" half (e.g. "SET_NULL — preserves them"). Ignored for other shapes.

edge.description: An edge between two nodes within the same step. CROSS-REFERENCE RULE: both `from` and `to` MUST be node ids that exist in the parent step's nodes[].

from.description: Source node id (must exist in parent step's nodes[]).

to.description: Target node id (must exist in parent step's nodes[]).

from_side.description: Optional hint for which side of the source node the edge departs from. Layout engine may override.

style.description: Optional visual variant. soft = lighter weight (transitive/lateral); dashed = dashed line.

crossFlow.description: A cross-step edge connecting one step's output node to another step's input node. CROSS-REFERENCE RULES: from_step/to_step MUST resolve to steps[].step values; from_node MUST be a node id within from_step; to_node MUST be a node id within to_step; kind MUST be a key in top-level kinds (when kinds is present).

from_step.description: Source step number (must match a steps[].step value).

from_node.description: Source node id (must exist in the from_step's nodes[]).

to_step.description: Target step number (must match a steps[].step value).

to_node.description: Target node id (must exist in the to_step's nodes[]).

label.description: Short label for the flow (e.g. "HashedRow", "retry signal"). Shown on the edge.

kind.description: Kind slug (must be a key in top-level kinds when kinds is present). Determines edge colour. Canonical values: data, control, schema, queue, utility, observability.

style.description: Optional visual variant. soft = lighter weight; dashed = dashed line.
